title: SPEKTRAN virtual instrument configuration
description: Schema (v0.1 draft) for a virtual-instrument YAML/JSON config. A virtual instrument defines DISTRIBUTIONS for every noise/instrument parameter; the generator samples one concrete value per record and writes it to the record's provenance.noise_config.

held_out.description: Held-out instruments feed ONLY test splits (cross-instrument generalization track); their configs must not overlap the training distribution.

scan_nonlinearity_poly_cm1.description: Distributions for polynomial coefficients (cm-1 per normalized-ramp^k, order 2+ terms) of current->wavenumber scan nonlinearity.

ram_amplitude_rel.description: Residual amplitude modulation, relative intensity amplitude.

mode_hop_probability.description: Probability of a mode hop per scan (0 to 1). DFB lasers: typically < 0.01.

mode_hop_size_cm1.description: Frequency jump size on mode hop [cm-1]. Typical DFB: 0.1 to 0.5.

tuning_model.description: Optional physically-motivated current->frequency tuning model, replacing scan_nonlinearity_poly_cm1. 'thermal_chirp' splits scan_range_cm1 into an instantaneous current (plasma) term and a thermally-lagged term (see tuning_params).

thermal_fraction.description: Fraction of scan_range_cm1 due to thermal chirp (0 to 1); remainder is instantaneous current chirp.

thermal_tau_norm.description: Thermal time constant normalized to scan duration (tau_th / T_scan).

harmonics.description: Harmonics to demodulate. Default [1, 2]; extend to [1, 2, 3, 4] for higher-harmonic detection.

etalons.description: Periodic interference fringes; each entry is one etalon.

amplitude_rel.description: Fringe amplitude relative to DC transmitted intensity.

baseline_poly_rel.description: Distributions for slow polynomial baseline coefficients (relative).

intensity_ramp_slope_rel.description: Linear laser-intensity change over the current scan (relative, edge-to-edge/2).

window_contamination_rel.description: Broadband fractional transmission loss from window fouling (0 = clean).

window_spectral_slope.description: Spectral exponent of wavelength-dependent scattering (0 = flat, 4 = Rayleigh).

beam_wander_sigma_rel.description: Standard deviation of beam-wander intensity modulation (relative).

beam_wander_cutoff_norm.description: Beam wander low-pass cutoff as fraction of Nyquist rate.

gas_flow_turbulence_sigma_rel.description: Std-dev of multiplicative refractive-index fluctuation from gas flow (relative). Typical: 1e-5 to 5e-4.

gas_flow_turbulence_cutoff.description: Low-pass cutoff (fraction of Nyquist) for turbulence filter.

baseline_drift_coeffs_sigma.description: Sigma of OU-process polynomial drift coefficients (order 1, 2, ...). Replaces baseline_poly_rel when present.

baseline_drift_tau.description: OU correlation time in scans for baseline drift. Typical: 10 to 100.

white_noise_rel.description: White-noise sigma relative to full-scale signal.

one_over_f_sigma_rel.description: Total sigma of the 1/f^slope noise component, relative to full scale.

detector_temperature_K.description: Detector operating temperature [K]. Defaults to environment T if absent.

reference_temperature_K.description: Reference temperature for noise specs [K]. Default 296.

dark_current_sigma_rel.description: Dark-current noise sigma at reference temperature (relative to full scale).

dark_current_activation_eV.description: Activation energy for dark current Arrhenius scaling [eV]. InGaAs ~0.37.

rin_dBc_Hz.description: Laser relative intensity noise spectral density [dBc/Hz]. Typical: -130 to -160.

tia_bandwidth_Hz.description: Transimpedance amplifier bandwidth [Hz]. Low-pass filter before ADC.

responsivity_cutoff_cm1.description: Detector responsivity long-wavelength cutoff [cm-1]. InGaAs standard: 5882.

responsivity_rolloff_cm1.description: Width of the responsivity sigmoid roll-off [cm-1]. Default 200.

shot_noise_gain.description: Shot-noise scaling factor: sigma = gain * sqrt(|signal|). Typical InGaAs: 1e-4 to 1e-3.

emi_frequencies_Hz.description: Frequencies of periodic electromagnetic interference [Hz]. Typically 50 or 60 Hz mains + harmonics.

speckle_noise_sigma.description: Sigma of spectrally-correlated speckle noise (relative). Typical: 1e-5 to 5e-4.

speckle_correlation_length.description: Correlation length in samples for speckle noise. Typical: 5 to 50.

gain_cubic_rel.description: Cubic gain nonlinearity coefficient: output += cubic_rel * signal^3.

saturation_level.description: Detector saturation level (tanh clamp). 0 = no saturation.

clock_jitter_rel.description: ADC clock jitter sigma (relative to sample interval). Typical: 1e-6 to 1e-4.

h2o_continuum_fraction.description: H2O mole fraction for MT_CKD continuum absorption. 0 = disable.

reference_channel.description: Reference channel for common-mode noise rejection (balanced detection).

noise_sigma_rel.description: White-noise sigma on the reference channel (relative).

multipass_etalon.description: Multi-pass cell etalon (Herriott/White cell). Replaces 'etalons' when present.

n_passes.description: Number of passes through the cell. Typical: 10 to 100.

base_fsr_cm1.description: Free spectral range of the base cavity [cm-1].

amplitude_decay.description: Per-pass amplitude decay factor (0 to 1). Typical: 0.7 to 0.95.

gas_path_layers.description: Non-uniform gas path: each layer has distinct T, P, concentration scaling. Fractions must sum to ~1.

length_fraction.description: Fraction of total path length for this layer.

concentration_scale.description: Multiplicative factor for target concentration in this layer.

performance.description: Derived performance metrics characterizing this virtual instrument (fixed numbers, not distributions). Computed from generated data; anchored against literature ranges in Gate G4.

snr_typical.description: Typical signal-to-noise ratio of the peak signal (dimensionless).

detection_bandwidth_Hz.description: Bandwidth at which detection_limit_ppm is stated.

allan_min_ppm.description: Minimum of the Allan(-Werle) deviation curve.

accuracy_rel.description: Relative bias vs known simulated truth.

linearity_r2.description: R^2 of the concentration-response calibration curve (dimensionless).

dist_or_number.description: Either a fixed number or a sampling distribution.
